constant_scope: One full-validation Day-30-to-Day-60 mean raw neural residual per seed; fixed across anchors, leads and bootstrap resamples
constant_interpretation: Post-hoc validation-prediction decomposition, not a training-fitted deployable control; no target values used to fit the constant
last_obs_only: Keep prefix length and day indices; erase earlier value, observed, age and known-history channels; retain last observation and subsequent age
flat_history: Replace prior observed values by latest observed score; preserve all masks, ages, day indices, lengths, leads and carried-forward score
